title: Perfect Roast Potatoes
subtitle: Crispy British roast potatoes with garlic and rosemary
excerpt: Floury potatoes parboiled until the edges fluff up, then tossed in very hot oil with garlic and rosemary. The result is crispy outside and fluffy inside.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from British roast potato technique. Parboiling and roughing up the surface before roasting are the two steps that make the most difference.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Parboil and rough up the potatoes up to 4 hours ahead. Keep uncovered at room temperature. Roast from room temperature.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 200C / Gas 7. The oven must be fully up to temperature before the potatoes go in.

content.text: The oil must be smoking before the potatoes go in. If the oil is not hot enough the potatoes will stick and not crisp.

items.prepNote: floury variety such as Maris Piper or King Edward, peeled and cut into large chunks

content.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Pour the sunflower oil into a large roasting tin and put it in the oven to heat up.
Put the potato chunks in a large saucepan. Cover with cold salted water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the outside is just starting to soften.
Drain the potatoes in a colander. Leave them to steam-dry for 2 minutes. Then shake the colander vigorously to rough up the edges. Season with salt.
Remove the hot roasting tin from the oven. Carefully tip the potatoes in. They should sizzle loudly on contact with the oil. Toss to coat.
Add the garlic cloves, rosemary, and thyme. Toss to distribute.
Roast for 45 to 50 minutes, turning once halfway through, until deeply golden and crispy on all sides.

items.symptom: Potatoes are sticking to the tin.
items.cause: Oil was not hot enough when potatoes were added.
items.fix: Heat the tin in the oven for at least 10 minutes before adding potatoes.

items.symptom: Potatoes are not crispy after 50 minutes.
items.cause: Oven temperature was too low or tin was overcrowded.
items.fix: Use two tins and ensure all pieces have space between them.

items.symptom: Outside is crispy but inside is not cooked.
items.fix: Parboil for a full 10 minutes so the inside has a head start.
